# Forms and the items they serve

Vocabulary is calibrated separately for each language. The fixed form
serves a set list of items; the adaptive form picks items near the
child's current estimate. If the fixed list is easy relative to the bank,
the strongest children see few items near their ability and their scores
are imprecise.

```{r vocab-seen}
vocab_seen <- trials |>
  filter(calibrated) |>
  inner_join(items |> select(item_uid, lang, bank_difficulty = difficulty),
             by = c("item_uid", "lang")) |>
  mutate(form = if_else(adaptive, "adaptive", "fixed"), language = lang_names[lang])
seen_summary <- vocab_seen |>
  group_by(language, form) |>
  summarise(median = median(bank_difficulty), .groups = "drop")
bank_summary <- items |>
  group_by(language = lang_names[lang]) |>
  summarise(median = median(difficulty), top = quantile(difficulty, .9), .groups = "drop")
high_se <- runs |>
  filter(!is.na(score_se)) |>
  mutate(form = if_else(adaptive, "adaptive", "fixed"), high = score > 1) |>
  filter(high) |>
  group_by(form) |>
  summarise(n = n(), median_se = median(score_se), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r vocab-seen-plot, fig.height=4}
#| label: fig-vocab-seen
#| fig-cap: "Difficulty of the items children saw on each form, against the whole bank (dashed), by language."
ggplot(vocab_seen, aes(x = bank_difficulty)) +
  geom_density(aes(fill = form), alpha = 0.45, colour = NA) +
  geom_density(data = items |> mutate(language = lang_names[lang]), aes(x = difficulty),
               linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(vars(language)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(adaptive = "#4477AA", fixed = "#CC6677"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Item difficulty", y = "Density") +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

```{r vocab-se-plot, fig.height=4}
#| label: fig-vocab-se
#| fig-cap: "Standard error of each score against the score, by form and language."
runs |>
  filter(!is.na(score_se), substr(language, 1, 2) %in% item_langs) |>
  mutate(form = if_else(adaptive, "adaptive", "fixed"),
         language = lang_names[substr(language, 1, 2)]) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = score, y = score_se, colour = form)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.15, size = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(vars(language)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(adaptive = "#4477AA", fixed = "#CC6677"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Score", y = "Standard error") +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

Median difficulty of the items seen: `r with(seen_summary, paste0(language, " ", form, " ", f2(median), collapse = "; "))`;
the banks' medians are `r with(bank_summary, paste0(language, " ", f2(median), collapse = ", "))`.
For children scoring above 1, the median standard error is
`r with(high_se, paste0(f2(median_se), " on the ", form, " form (n = ", fmt_n(n), ")", collapse = " and "))`.
`r se_fixed <- high_se$median_se[high_se$form == "fixed"]; se_adapt <- high_se$median_se[high_se$form == "adaptive"]; if (length(se_fixed) && length(se_adapt)) (if (se_fixed > se_adapt) "So the easier fixed list does cost the strongest children precision." else "So in this release the easier fixed list does not cost the strongest children precision, though few children above 1 took the fixed form.") else ""`

# Open issues

`r below_chance_issue()`
- Scores are on a separate scale in each language, so comparing levels
  across languages needs a linking design; see
  [items across languages](../monitor/languages.qmd).
- Vocabulary scores before registry v1.2 were badly affected by the
  scoring code's item-order bug, since fixed
  ([IRT column-order study](../studies/2026-06_irt-column-order-bug/math_eap_vs_ml.qmd)).
  Analyses that used older scores, including the earlier picture of a
  vocabulary decline between waves in Leipzig, need the current scores.
